newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RGC sees Bolivian tin sale early 97.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RGC sees Bolivian tin sale early 97.

text.p: Base metals and mineral sands miner RGC Ltd said on Wednesday it expects a final decision on the sale of the tin assets of Bolivian state-owned group COMIBOL mining group to be made by early 1997.
"We expect that to be finalised in the next three months say by early calendar 1997," RGC managing director Mark Bethwaite told reporters after the company's annual meeting.
COMIBOL owns the Vinto tin smelter and two tin mines, Colquiri and Huanuni, which supply Vinto's concentrate feed, which is then smelted into tin.

"If we acquire those resources and we develop them to what we believe to be an appropriate level based on the reserves, we would take our western world market share from about 15 percent to 30 percent, so it will make us a major player in the tin market," Bethwaite said.
Bethwaite said RGC was on the short list with two other miners.
RGC, which is 40 percent owned by British conglomerate Hanson Plc, produced about 16,000 tonnes of tin in the 1995/96 year.
